main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu grass on alluvial river soil base)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Premier country circuit on the NSW Mid-North Coast operated by the Manning Valley Race Club. Features a unique triangular-shaped 1,530m oval with tight cambered turns and a 350m home straight. The tight triangular geometry generates a heavy early speed ('E' style) and on-pace presser ('P' style) bias. Deep closers ('S' and 'C' styles) struggle unless drawn inside to save ground along the fence.
main_turf.post_bias: STRONG INSIDE BARRIER BIAS: Barrier draws 1 through 5 hold a distinct edge across all sprint distances (1000m, 1250m, 1400m). Outer draws (9+) expend significant early energy to cross over or get trapped wide on the tight turns.

handicapping_angles.taree_cup_showcase_feature: The Taree Cup ($100k+ Showcase Handicap, August) is the marquee winter event of the Mid-North Coast. Race quality elevates to NSW Provincial standard. Upgrade horses with proven Newcastle, Wyong, or Sydney midweek benchmark form (+3.5 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.hunter_and_provincial_shipper_advantage: Taree attracts high-volume entries from Newcastle, Port Macquarie, Scone, and Hawkesbury stables (e.g. Kris Lees, Nathan Doyle, Paul Perry, Kristen Buchanan, Colt Prosser). Provincial class-dropping runners carry a major speed figure advantage over regional country rivals (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.triangular_speed_bias: Because of the tight triangular layout and sharp corners, pure front-runners ('E' style) and box-seaters ('P' style) have a significant edge. Downgrade deep swoopers ('C' style) unless drawn inside.
handicapping_angles.kikuyu_wet_track_durability: Taree's dense Kikuyu grass surface drains exceptionally well and handles heavy rain better than inland bush tracks. Soft and Heavy ratings often play slightly firmer than official ratings suggest.
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Standard distances: 1000m, 1250m, 1300m, 1400m, 1600m, 2000m. Dedicated chutes at 1000m and 1400m.
